An unmatched [ in image alt text is escaped so the image survives

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<img alt=\"[A;B)\" src=\"S\">", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
